connection: per-call sqlite3.connect via get_connection() helper (sqlite3 stdlib)
queries: JOIN of order_items and orders filtered by restaurant_id and a created_at day prefix, then a Python loop that sums quantity * unit_price_cents per order
n_plus_one: none: one fetch plus in-memory aggregation

optimization_targets.description: Replace the Python loop that computes per-order totals with a single SQL aggregation (SUM grouped by order id) to reduce data transfer and memory usage

notes: The result must map every order id to its own total for the given restaurant and day, and the daily revenue helper must keep returning 0 for an empty day
